summary: [spec fidelity] A tool-wide option with no value followed by --json and then the command is read as taking the command as its value: `canon finding --repo --json list --change x` is USAGE field --change (unexpected argument), not field --repo. relocate_json moves --json to the end before the hoist sees the argv, so `--repo --json list` and `--repo list --json` are the same words by then; only `--repo --json` at the end of the group (the case scenario 16 names) is caught. Same as typing `--repo list`, so no change asked; the error still names an option, exit 2, nothing written. Also `finding --repo --json` reports received `--repo` (clap's unknown-argument form, as for `--bogus`) while `finding --as --json` has no received; both are accepted by the test and consistent with 0.33's convention for an unknown option. Blast radius: argv shapes with a valueless tool-wide option before a group's command.
